p, k = map(int, input().split())
MOD = 10**9 + 7

def pow_mod(a, b):
    ret = 1
    while b:
        if b & 1:
            ret = ret * a % MOD
        b >>= 1
        a = a * a % MOD
    return ret

if k == 1:
    print(pow_mod(p, p))
else:
    w = [0] * (p)
    for i in range(1, p):
        w[i] = (k * i) % p

    vis = [False] * p
    cnt = 0
    for i in range(1, p):
        if vis[i]:
            continue
        t = i
        while not vis[t]:
            vis[t] = True
            t = w[t]
        cnt += 1

    print(pow_mod(p, cnt))
